<div class="card-body">
'''Timer Mine (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タイマー地雷</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の地雷敷設ドロイドがいる位置カードの相手の側に配備する。次の自分のターンに「爆発」する。運命数を引く。そこにいる相手のキャラクターが運命数の数だけ即座にロストする（誰をロストするかは敵が選べる）。その時点でタイマー地雷もロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Timer-Mine-Dark-SWCA-100703.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">地雷敷設用ドロイドによって仕掛けられる時限式の爆弾。鉱脈やスパイス鉱山の爆破用に開発されたが、軍用に改造されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Timer Mine (Dark).

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on the opponent's side of a location card where one of your mine-laying droids is present. It "explodes" on your next turn. Draw destiny. That many opposing characters there are immediately lost; the opponent may choose who is lost. The timer mine is also lost at that point.

'''Lore:'''
A timed bomb set by a mine-laying droid. Developed for blasting ore veins and spice mines, it has been modified for military use.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese deploys at a location card and explodes on your next turn.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Timer Mine (Dark)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
